$comment: WLED UDP realtime datagrams worked out by hand from https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/udp-realtime/ (not by running the plugin). Byte 0 = protocol (2 DRGB, 4 DNRGB), byte 1 = timeout in seconds. DRGB: byte 2+3n = R of LED n, then G, B; up to 490 LEDs. DNRGB: bytes 2-3 = start index (high byte first), byte 4+3n = R of LED start+n; up to 489 LEDs per datagram. Lightloom uses timeout 2 while streaming and 1 for the shutdown packet.

drgb_red_green_shutdown.$comment: same colours, timeout 1 s (sent once by Shutdown)

drgb_490.$comment: 490 LEDs (the DRGB limit) all #123456: one datagram, 2 + 490*3 = 1472 bytes

dnrgb_500.$comment: 500 LEDs all #123456: more than 490, so DNRGB. Datagram 1 starts at LED 0 (00 00) with 489 LEDs: 4 + 1467 = 1471 bytes. Datagram 2 starts at LED 489 = 0x01E9 (01 E9) with the remaining 11 LEDs: 4 + 33 = 37 bytes.

info.$comment: A trimmed GET /json/info answer, field names as in the WLED JSON API docs (https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/json-api/).
